button.label: Chat
button.supertip: Ask about this workbook in plain language. The agent can read what is on the sheets and propose cell edits you approve.

button.label: Ask about selection
button.supertip: Opens the panel with a question about the current selection already drafted.

button.label: Summarise sheet
button.supertip: Asks the agent for a short summary of the active sheet.

button.label: Clear conversation
button.supertip: Clears the chat history and any pending edits. Sheet data is untouched.
